name: Radiant
description: An archangel leading Serra's Realm's forces, who declares Urza a Phyrexian and is destroyed rejoining his powerstone eyes.

description_citations.text: "Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant tells Serra to go and leave the world to those who truly care.
timeline.quote: Go, then," the angel spat at Serra

citation.text: Catastrophe (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra tells Radiant it is not her place to rule.
timeline.quote: It is not your place to rule, Radiant.

citation.text: Humble (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant prays that Lady Selenia died honorably after her loss to the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians.

citation.text: Persecute (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza tells Radiant to let her people go or they will die sealed away.
timeline.quote: Let them go, and they will live; seal them here, and they will die.

citation.text: Angelic Curator (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant stands ready to die for her world and asks who will join.
timeline.quote: I stand ready to die for our world. Who will stand with me?

citation.text: Burst of Energy (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant says Serra ruled by faith and she cannot afford it.
timeline.quote: Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury.

citation.text: Hope and Glory (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant announces Urza has returned and calls for swift and certain death.
timeline.quote: How shall we greet him? With swift and certain death!

citation.text: Knighthood (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant tells Urza the harder he pushes, the stronger they become.
timeline.quote: The harder you push, the stronger we become.

citation.text: Sustainer of the Realm (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm, drives away Serra, and leads to Radiant's coup; Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza was able to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria

citation.text: "Angel", section "Serra angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant plucks the stones from Urza's eyes in Serra's Sanctum and dies when she puts them together, restoring Urza.
timeline.quote: Radiant then foolishly put the two stones together, triggering an explosion that killed the angel and restored Urza.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Reunification in Urza, Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians track Urza to the realm, taint it, and Serra abandons it, entrusting Radiant.
timeline.quote: entrusting the archangel Radiant as its caretaker in her absence

citation.text: "Serra", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant's corrupted angels slaughter the Realm's inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Radiant's corrupted angels becoming a terrible winged army

citation.text: "Serra", section "Radiant and the end of the Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant takes control and, trying to expunge Phyrexian influence, becomes their unwitting tool and exterminates loyal Serrans.
timeline.quote: Radiant became an unwitting tool of the Phyrexians and began exterminating loyal Serrans.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza visits Serra's Realm and meets Radiant, who reprimands him, lets him watch her purification armies, then refuses to let him take refugees and declares him a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Radiant refuses and declares him a Phyrexian

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza evacuates refugees and learns Radiant's soul torches are siphoning the plane's white mana through her sleeper Gorig.
timeline.quote: Urza repeatedly returns to Serra's Realm to evacuate hundreds of refugees to Dominaria

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Serra's Realm Barrin tricks Gorig into impaling itself on the Weatherlight, charging the powerstone, while Radiant kills Gherridarigaaz and rips out Urza's powerstone eyes.
timeline.quote: Radiant challenges Urza to single combat and kills Gherridarigaaz.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant tries to rejoin the powerstones, causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza; the crew escapes as Serra's Realm collapses.
timeline.quote: causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: her sleeper Phyrexian war minister Gorig

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Archangel of Serra's realm who counsels hard rule.

citation.text: Urza's Saga: card flavor text (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Archangel ruling Serra's realm, who vows to die for her world and resents Urza.

citation.text: Urza's Legacy: card flavor text (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Archangel who lost her finest warrior to the Phyrexians.

citation.text: World Championship Decks 1999: card flavor text (World Championship Decks 1999, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Archangel who tells Serra to leave the world.

citation.work: Battle Royale Box Set: card flavor text
citation.text: Battle Royale Box Set: card flavor text (Battle Royale Box Set, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A Serra Angel who led a coup in Serra's Realm after Phyrexian corruption drove Serra away.

citation.text: "Angel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An angel who replaced Serra, plucked the stones from Urza's eyes, and died when she put them together.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Archangel caretaker who became corrupted by Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Serra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Serra's head archangel who took control with militancy and paranoia and became a tool of the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
